package.name: pb_gazebo_sim_support
package.description: Gazebo (Fortress) simulation-support systems for the PB vehicle. Provides ChassisTruth: a same-step, simulation-time-stamped six-degree-of-freedom chassis ground-truth source, so the navigation TF/odometry chain has one measurement instead of a fusion of two asynchronous streams. Also provides ContactDiagnostics: read-only contact/actuator diagnostics, default off and explicitly switched, which never modify physics.
